ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (the "Agreement"), made as of the 31* day of March, 2006 by and between 111 WEST 24" ST. ASSOCIATES, having an address at 65 Price Parkway, Farmingdale, New York 11735 ("Owner") and 735 AVENUE OF THE AMERICAS LLC, having an office c/o LCOR Incorporated, One Penn Plaza, Suite 3310,NewYork,NewYork 10119 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is thefee owner of a certain parcel of land, together with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork,known as Lot 33inBlock800on the TaxMap of the City of NewYork,and by the street address 111 West 24 Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner's Land"; the building and improvements thereon together with any future additions, alterations or replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, the “Owner's Building"; and the Owner's Land and Owner's Building, collectively, the “Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS,Developer is thefee owner of a certain parcel of land,togetherwith the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork, known as Lots 37 and 46in Block 800 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and by the street address 735 Avenue of theAmericas,NewYork,New York and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer's Land"; the building and improvements thereon together with any future additions, alterations or replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, the “Developer's Building"; and the Developer's Land and the Developer's Building, collectively, the "Developer'sPremises"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct on Developer's Land and on a portion of Owner's Premises in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement a new building (the new building and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations or replacements thereof permitted by the provisions of this Agreement, the “New Building"); WHEREAS,it is contemplated that theNewBuilding will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on Developer's Land and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) to combine the zoning lot comprised of Developer's Land (the “Merged Zoning Lot") to make available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Building;
